annotations.title: Find ways to serve: open needs from verified partners

description: PURPOSE: Find open needs on The Living Bread Serve network, posted by verified partner ministries and Christian nonprofits: what is needed, urgency, approximate place, the partner, estimated cost, and whether it can be met in person, remotely or by funding. WHEN TO USE: "how can I help near Kigali", "a need I can fund", "volunteer from home". WHEN NOT: someone who needs prayer or a person to talk to: find_people_to_pray_with. Gatherings to attend: find_gatherings. Committing to a need is a signed-in act on /me (offer_to_serve). MODES (required parameters in brackets): near [none] nearest first within 250 km of lat and lng or city, or by country, or the whole network when no place is given (limit 1 to 20, default 8). public_needs [none] needs that ask for people, filtered by city or country name, remote_only true for needs met from anywhere. OUTPUT: mode, answered_by, and searched, count, needs [{id, title, description, category, urgency, where, distance_km, partner, ways, estimated_cost, pilot, door}], honest when empty, and the door to Serve. BEHAVIOR: read only; reads live data. Places are approximate (city, region, country), never a home address. When none is near, near returns count 0 with up to 5 remote or fundable needs instead. Parameters a mode does not use are ignored and named in ignored_params. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

city.description: A city: geocoded for near, matched by name for public_needs.

country.description: A country name (or ISO code for public_needs): "Rwanda", "Kenya".

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, only if the person shared their location; pair with lng. Coordinates win over city.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, paired with lat.

mode.description: Which kind of answer: near, public_needs. Each mode, and the parameters it needs, is explained in the description.

remote_only.description: For public_needs: true lists only needs that can be met remotely.

name: find_ways_to_serve

answered_by.description: The implementation that answered (the same tool name the signed-in endpoint lists).

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

ignored_params.description: Parameters given that this mode does not use.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

title: Find ways to serve: open needs from verified partners
